title: fix(cli): respect aspect-ratio in gen video and support multiple reference frames
author: Saauf

gist.summary: `polli gen video` now sends `width` and `height` only when explicitly provided, so `--aspect-ratio 16:9` no longer competes with an implicit 1024×1024 size. It still defaults to 1024×1024 when neither an aspect ratio nor dimensions are specified. `--image` now accepts multiple reference-frame URLs and joins them with `|`, matching `polli gen image` and supporting start and end frames. Unit tests cover the video command changes.
